description: Exact P/L at expiry for a position of up to 8 legs (calls, puts, shares, long or short): net premium (debit or credit), breakevens, highest and lowest P/L at expiry (or Unlimited), and the P/L at each strike and at any underlying prices given. Covers spreads, straddles, strangles, iron condors, butterflies, covered calls and collars. Uses only the numbers supplied.

legs.description: The position: 1 to 8 legs (calls, puts or shares, long or short).

price.description: Premium per share for an option, or the price paid per share for stock.

quantity.description: Contracts for an option, shares for stock.

side.description: long = bought (premium paid), short = written or sold short (premium received).

type.description: The leg: a call option, a put option, or shares of the underlying stock.

prices_at_expiry.description: Optional underlying prices at expiry to evaluate.

items.description: Dollars per share, at most 4 decimals, for example "2.35".

name: options_pnl_at_expiry
title: Options P/L at expiry
